text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kyoto Racecourse is abuzz with cheers for the Mejiro runners, proof of the great expectations they've shouldered on their path to this moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But what does it mean to face your fans? Ines Fujin watches the Mejiro racers intently, hoping to learn what it takes to answer fans' expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for Ines to take on the two powerhouses Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen. The spring Tenno Sho awaits!
